Kind: Native BimGo exported-geometry solve, not WWTools/Revit parity
Warnings: Geometry basis: exported BimGo triangles, not a certified WWTools extraction. Omitted launch categories/links cannot block or reflect light.
Scalar diffuse, electric light only; no daylight, colored bounce, specular or glass transport. Class reflectances are explicit calculation assumptions.

Exported room plan coordinates are rounded to 0.00001 ft for grid layout, preventing float unit-conversion noise from dropping a complete grid row. Physical transport triangles retain their exported positions.
Transparent exported faces are treated as openings. Fixture housing geometry is excluded. Source candela uses full IES output times the chosen LLF, without preview brightness or lumen rescaling.
Transport domain: selected room union plus 15 ft XY, 1.5 ft below and 3 ft above; connections outside this domain are not modeled.
This domain includes transparent faces, omitted from the opaque transport mesh.
26 source(s) use explicitly allowed estimated analytic distributions/output. This is not verified manufacturer photometry.
